parallel.requirements: The parent recognized the Python-to-Node migration, ESM-only, .mjs, no npm, manual argv parsing, /output placement, and differential behavior requirements.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: It launched a workflow with a serial semantics phase, seven disjoint implementation owners, an integrator, five verifier lenses, possible fixer, and final gatekeeper.
parallel.implementation: Only the analysis module group completed and wrote five files; compat, fields, index, query, searching, integration, and final entry work were interrupted, retried, or never reached completion.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: No integrator result landed, final.txt is empty, and artifact validation copied only lib/analysis files while expected test11.mjs was absent.
parallel.verification: The parent and research children probed ground truth, and the analysis child ran syntax and tokenizer checks, but no integrated test11.mjs verification completed.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The outer agent timed out at the full budget, artifact validation failed, the official evaluator scored 0/70, and the required entry point was missing.

serial.requirements: The serial agent recognized the same source, command line, ESM, .mjs, no dependency, output, and behavioral matching requirements.
serial.plan_and_ownership: A single agent kept ownership of probing, all module implementation, entry assembly, verification, compliance checks, and the final report.
serial.implementation: It wrote support argparse/tempfile modules, a whoosh library tree, a barrel file, and test11.mjs that builds an index and prints the result count.
serial.integration_and_delivery: It assembled the import graph and entry file directly in /output, delivered a final response, and artifact validation found the expected entry.
serial.verification: It ran the entry, a 24-case differential sweep against the executable, an index/search self-check, and compliance scans for forbidden module patterns.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The official evaluator still marked the solution not passed, with 49/70 samples passing, so residual implementation gaps remained despite a complete artifact.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel recognized the stated ESM/no-dependency/manual-argv requirements and embedded them into a workflow contract.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial recognized the same requirements through prompt, source reading, executable probes, and direct implementation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Requirement recognition was broadly similar; the difference was that serial converted it into a delivered tree while parallel lost the deliverable in orchestration.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel split work into semantics lenses, seven module groups, an integrator, verifier lenses, refuters, fixer, and final gate.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial kept all probing, implementation, integration, and verification under one actor.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had many owners and dependencies; serial used one coherent implementation path with fewer handoff boundaries.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel supplied a detailed locked contract, but also passed large handoffs and allowed a /tmp reference artifact to enter later implementation context.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial maintained context locally and encoded interfaces directly in written imports and exports.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had more transfer surfaces and a contaminated scratch artifact; serial had no cross-agent interface handoff.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel completed analysis modules only; most module groups did not return and no entry file was created.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote support, analysis, fields, storage, index, query, search, parser, barrel, and entry modules.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial produced a runnable implementation; parallel produced only a partial library subset.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Several implementation children were interrupted and retried, only the analysis result is visible in the journal, and the parent never received a final workflow result.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial kept local results in one trajectory and immediately used writes, command output, differential checks, and self-checks before final response.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had stalled or lost child result lifecycle; serial had continuous result consumption.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel planned an integrator but timed out with only shared-workspace analysis files, and one compat child read a generated /tmp reference artifact.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial integrated its imports, barrel, and entry file in a single tree and audited for forbidden imports and file types.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial delivered an assembled final tree; parallel had partial shared state and contaminated scratch-artifact provenance.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel planned extensive verification, but the executable entry never existed and no integrated differential sweep completed.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial ran the generated program, completed 24 differential cases, ran a self-check, and performed compliance scans before final response.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial verified a whole artifact; parallel verified only pieces and then failed artifact validation and official evaluation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel consumed the full 2399-second agent timeout with 21 subagents and no final response.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial completed in 580.704 agent seconds with 1817 seconds remaining in the provider retry budget.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel's orchestration left no closure budget; serial closed with a delivered artifact and final explanation.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current completed status evaluation marks both solutions as not passed, so there is no discordant pass/fail outcome. The material difference is quality and completeness: serial delivered a runnable artifact with test11.mjs, a library tree, differential tests, self-checks, and 49/70 official samples; parallel timed out, left final.txt empty, copied only five analysis files with no entry point, and scored 0/70.
parallel_contributors: The parallel workflow serialized a long semantics phase before implementation.
It then fanned out broad implementation and verification work that exhausted the budget.
Interrupted module owners were retried without reusable checkpoints.
A compat child consumed a generated /tmp reference artifact from another child.
serial_contributors: The serial run kept implementation and verification in one actor and wrote the complete output tree.
It ran a local entry check, a 24-case differential sweep, a self-check, and compliance scans before final response.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Serial still failed the official criterion despite 49/70, indicating remaining fidelity defects in the generated port.
Parallel did not reach enough implementation surface for ordinary coding defects in most modules to be evaluated.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: supported comparative contributors to the quality gap; both official solution_passed values are false

candidates.reason: The workflow explicitly assigned implementation groups, so implementation was owned even though most owners did not finish.
The workflow assigned an integrator for the barrel and entry file; it simply did not reach a completed integration.
Assembly of test11.mjs and the barrel was explicitly assigned to the integrator and later final gate.
The parent workflow script owned the end-to-end sequence from semantics through final validation.
The gate was not one mandatory preflight harness or oracle step; it was a multi-child research phase.
The workflow finished semantics as a separate first phase before starting implementation, delaying productive work and contributing to incomplete delivery.
candidates.realized_consequence: Productive implementation was delayed until the separate research phase returned, leaving the later build window deadline-constrained and incomplete.
candidates.near_match_reason: This was not one mandatory preflight step; multiple investigators formed a serial research phase before implementation.

candidates.reason: The evidence shows broad fan-out and serial investigation rather than auxiliary workers starving one identifiable critical path.
The workflow allocated seven implementation children plus verifier, refuter, fixer, and final-gate phases, and the process timed out before an integrated artifact existed.
candidates.realized_consequence: The collective workflow breadth and repeated starts consumed the deadline before test11.mjs or a complete module tree was produced.
candidates.near_match_reason: The failure is collective fan-out breadth, not one child with a uniquely oversized scope relative to siblings.

candidates.reason: No single child assignment is the best explanation; the budget loss is spread across semantics, many implementers, retries, and planned verification.
The child briefs carried the task requirements, measured ground truth, and output constraints; the adverse outcome came from timing and lifecycle, not omitted task facts.
The workflow provided an explicit locked file and export map for cross-module interfaces, so missing contract is not the coordination boundary.
There is no evidence that a known finding was omitted or truncated in transfer and then caused repeated work; the retained handoff issue is artifact leakage.
The briefs and digests are large, but the concrete adverse outcome is delay and budget exhaustion rather than a receiver unable to reduce returned information.
No receiver is shown acting on a superseded workspace or requirement state; late children inspected the current partial workspace.
No incompatible returned reports or contracts are shown reaching the parent and remaining unadjudicated.
The parallel parent did not present the whole task as complete; final.txt is empty and the process timed out.
The index module owner was interrupted and then relaunched under the same workflow task key, repeating source and workspace inspection without inherited checkpoint state.
candidates.realized_consequence: Repeated index implementation attempts consumed remaining build time on duplicated setup and never returned the index modules needed for the final artifact.
candidates.near_match_reason: The interruption is real, but the more specific retained boundary is the retry that lacked inherited checkpoint state and repeated prior work.

candidates.reason: Child interruptions are visible, but they are part of the retained checkpoint-free retry and fan-out exhaustion chains rather than an independent timing episode.
No complete promotable candidate or mutually compatible completed component set existed; only analysis modules were delivered.
No relevant integrated verification completed before a later merge; integration never produced the required entry.
The one completed implementation result wrote files directly into /output; the missing modules were unfinished, not completed and unjoined.
The planned verifier phase did not produce a concrete trapped verifier finding before closure; the absence is downstream of budget exhaustion.
There was no separate parent takeover decision after a child failure; the observed failures are captured by retries without checkpoints and overall timeout.
The completed analysis result was not ignored; its files are exactly the artifact copied. Other missing results were not completed and available.
The parent waited on an active workflow, but the stronger direct evidence is the workflow's serial gate, fan-out, and retry behavior.
The file/export map assigned disjoint module groups; no incompatible overlapping behavior or build ownership is shown.
No two live agents are shown editing the same source file and reconciling or observing a collision.
No child is shown replacing or deleting non-entry source produced by another owner.
The required entry deliverable was never written in the parallel artifact, so no overwrite of it is proven.
No broad cleanup, rebuild, or promotion replaced multiple current outputs; the final tree was simply incomplete.
Although live children shared /output, the concrete shared-state problem is the more specific /tmp artifact leakage, not an unqualified workspace-write instability.
A generated /tmp reference port created by an argparse research child was read and used by a later compat implementation child as stable input.
candidates.realized_consequence: The compat implementation path used a cross-child scratch artifact as reference input, contaminating provenance separately from the timeout outcome.
candidates.near_match_reason: The information was not lost through a handoff; a temporary generated artifact leaked through the shared environment and was consumed.

retained_patterns.reason: The workflow required the semantics lenses to finish before implementation could begin, so implementation and integration started after a long research gate.
retained_patterns.realized_consequence: Implementation and integration were pushed into a shortened closing window and remained incomplete at timeout.
retained_patterns.near_match_reason: The gate was a multi-agent research phase rather than one mandatory serial preflight.

retained_patterns.reason: The workflow fanned out seven implementation tasks and planned more verifier/refuter/fixer/final work, exhausting the finite run budget before a runnable artifact existed.
retained_patterns.realized_consequence: The final artifact lacked the required entry point and most modules because the budget expired while child work was still dispersed.
retained_patterns.near_match_reason: No single child dominates the failure; the collective breadth and retries exhausted time.

retained_patterns.reason: The index implementation child was interrupted and restarted under the same workflow task key, and replacements repeated source/workspace inspection rather than inheriting a checkpoint.
retained_patterns.realized_consequence: Index-module work repeated setup after interruption and never reached the completed output needed by the final tree.
retained_patterns.near_match_reason: The cancellation is part of the episode, but the retry without inherited state is the more specific context boundary.

retained_patterns.reason: A scratch /tmp reference port created by an argparse research child was consumed by a later compat implementation child.
retained_patterns.realized_consequence: Compat provenance was contaminated by cross-child scratch state, a separate adverse process consequence even though the official outcome gap is mainly from timeout and incomplete delivery.
retained_patterns.near_match_reason: The evidence is a leaked generated artifact, not missing information from a summary or handoff.

deduplicated_same_label_episodes: Multiple repeated child starts for index, query, fields, searching, and qparser were not counted as separate instances of Checkpoint-Free Retry; one pair-level retry episode is retained for the clearest index sequence.
suppressed_same_chain_candidates: Early Child Termination and No Failure Takeover were suppressed as downstream or less-specific views of the same interrupted child/retry chain.
Critical-Path Starvation and Oversized Child Task were suppressed because the budget loss is better represented by Serial Investigation plus Fan-out Budget Exhaustion.
cardinality_audit.underlabel_check: All 13 Level-2 rows and 32 Level-3 candidates were audited; retained labels cover the distinct serial gate, broad fan-out, retry, and artifact contamination episodes.
cardinality_audit.overlabel_check: No duplicate Level-3 label is retained, evidence sets are distinct, and timeout symptoms are not relabeled again as late finalization, blind waiting, or failure takeover.
